notes: 修复点 × 关闭后 push watcher 卡在 wait 不执行：WatchPid 被强杀后常留下一个无前台窗口的孤儿 DSH 子进程（启动时间比 watcher 还早），旧判据「所有 DSH 都比 watcher 新」被它破坏，watcher 死等 30 分钟还霸占 auto-sync.lock。判定改为「有无比 watcher 更早、且有前台窗口的 DSH 实例」——无窗口残留/新实例不再挡住过期让位，watcher 立即 exit 3 清锁让新 watcher 接管。保留 0.4.03 及以前全部修复。
notesEn: Fix watcher stuck in wait after × close: when WatchPid is force-killed it often leaves an orphan DSH child with no foreground window (started before the watcher); the old check 'all DSH newer than watcher' was broken by it, so the watcher idled 30 min holding auto-sync.lock. The check now looks for 'a DSH instance older than the watcher WITH a foreground window' — windowless leftovers/new instances no longer block stale-watcher handoff, so the watcher exits 3 and clears the lock immediately. Keeps 0.4.03 and all earlier fixes.
